description: React component for an onboarding modal with task management, including task list rendering, ignore functionality, and onboarding completion handling.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Type defining an onboarding task with properties like id, title, description, status, url, urlText, and optional onClick handler.

classes.name: OnboardingModalProps
classes.description: Type defining the props for the OnboardingModal component, including onClose callback, onboardingConfig, and optional onIgnoreTask callback.

methods.name: OnboardingModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering onboarding tasks, handling task ignore actions, and completing onboarding when all tasks are done.

methods.name: ignoreOnboardingTask
methods.description: Async function to update task status to 'done' or 'ignored' via API and trigger UI updates.

methods.name: ignoreForever
methods.description: Async function to set onboarding as ignored forever, update auth token, and reload page.
